key_insights: Market experiencing major contagion from 3AC, Celsius, and lending protocol insolvencies - creating liquidation cascades
Binance and Alameda increasingly dominating the market as other funds blow up
High yields in bull markets come from leverage demand that disappears when speculators blow up
200-week MA breakdown on BTC/ETH would be major bearish signal; reclaim would be bullish setup
Liquidity disappearing creating potential for both large down wicks and violent squeezes upside
Market sentiment at levels not seen since 2014, worse than 2018
Yield farming model fundamentally broken - only works in bull markets
DeFi yields always reflexive - high when bullish, non-existent when bearish
Alameda expected to be major buyer at bottom, likely to bid SOL among other alts
Current bounce plays are mean reversion trades, not calls for new bull market
3AC held equity in many crypto companies - illiquid and being fire-sold at distressed prices
3AC was doing treasury management for other projects - creates additional insolvency risks
3AC started buying at 45k and kept adding down, highly bullish and wrong
Lending services are distressed and having to sell collateral urgently
Bitfinex selling into bounces - usually knows what's up
S&P and BTC tracking - both at support levels
Duck's biggest position is SOL (up 10%), BTC and ETH underwater but balanced by SOL profits
If BTC loses $20k with no liquidity, could wick through $19, $18, $17 quickly

summary: Market in severe bear market with major contagion from 3AC liquidation and Celsius insolvency creating liquidation cascades. Binance and Alameda increasing dominance as other funds blow up. Duck positioned long BTC at $21.8k, targeting $28-32k bounce; long ETH targeting $1,800; biggest position SOL up 10% targeting $45-50. Key thesis: Alameda will bid SOL at bottom. 200-week MA breakdown on BTC would be bearish, reclaim would be bullish setup. Market sentiment at levels not seen since 2014.
